== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ジャンドラントの荒野</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値が6以上になる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分のタスケン・レイダーは没収値＋1。支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋1。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Jundland Wastes]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. The ability required to draw battle destiny becomes 6 or more. Dark Side. Your Tusken Raiders are forfeit +1. If you control, add 1 to the Force drain.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light says ability required to draw battle destiny becomes 6 or more. Dark omits English “here” and “each”. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-tatooinejundlandwastes.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Jundland Wastes]].</ref>
